description: This file defines the login feature for the user authentication system, including request handling, validation, and processing logic for user login in an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Holds user email and password data for login request.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Represents the login command containing user data, used with MediatR to process login requests.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the login command ensuring user email and password are provided.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles the login process: verifies user credentials, generates token, and returns user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Performs user authentication by verifying email and password, then generates a JWT token and returns user data.
